address.note: Exact street address is intentionally not public. Booksy shows the venue location field as 'Feel free to contact me with number on profile through WhatsApp!!, Miami, 33056'. This is a by-appointment barber (no walk-ins) that shares the exact address only after a booking is confirmed.

geo.source: Booksy venue payload coordinate (approximate, city/zip level)

google_business_check: Searched Google (web search + attempted WebFetch of Google Search and Google Maps result pages) for 'Cuban Clips barbershop Miami Gardens' and variants. No separate, distinctly identifiable Google Business/Maps listing for this specific 'Cuban Clips' (Miami Gardens, zip 33056) was found or renderable (Google Maps/Search are JS-rendered SPAs that returned no static content via WebFetch). Other similarly-named but UNRELATED businesses exist in Google-indexed directories ('The Original Cuban Barbershop' at 1612 SW 8th St Miami, 'Cuban 305 Barber Shop' at 803 SW 5th Ave Miami) and were NOT used for any data here. Per PIPELINE.md fallback, Booksy (the business's own live booking platform payload) was used as the source of truth for rating/reviews/services since it is a first-party, verifiable, structured data source and no distinct Google listing could be confirmed for this exact business.
reviews_count_source: Booksy venue payload field reviewsCount=83 (matches the vetting brief's ~83). reviewsRank raw value 4.891566265060241 rounds to the 4.9 displayed by Booksy.
hours_note: Booksy exposes no fixed recurring weekly hours for this venue (openHours: [] in the payload); only near-term per-date availability windows are shown (e.g. Jul 30, 2026: 10:00-17:30; Jul 31, 2026: 9:00-12:30). Business is appointment-only via the Booksy app, no walk-ins. openingHoursNote from Booksy: 'All no call / no shows, will be charged a fee through app or included into next service, no acceptions!! Please double check that desired time and service has been confirmed before showing up for your appointment!!'
instagram_source: Confirmed via the instagramLink field of the Booksy venue payload (business id 172216).
instagram_scrape_status: Blocked in this environment: the IG web_profile_info endpoint returned HTTP 400 with message 'Asset asset://laser.provider/ig_business_category_subvertical has been deleted. You cannot use this schema' (same class of failure documented in prior builds, e.g. isa-nails-hollywood). Handle confirmed via Booksy but no additional bio/photos/business_email could be pulled from Instagram directly.
own_site_check: Tried cubanclips.com, cubanclipsmiami.com, cubanclipsbarbershop.com, cuban-clips.com and cubanclipsig.com via curl: all returned HTTP 000 (no DNS/connection). Booksy payload field website=null, facebookLink=null. No standalone domain found.
phone_source: Not public. The Booksy page surfaces a generic Booksy platform support number (+1 206-735-3553), not the business's own number (same known Booksy pattern seen in other builds). The business's real contact method is WhatsApp, but the number is only shared with clients after booking through the app ('Feel free to contact me with number on profile through WhatsApp!!'), so no public business phone number exists to publish.
email_search_notes: No email field in the Booksy business payload. No Facebook page found to check an About section. Instagram bio/business_email unreachable due to the API block described above. No own domain to derive an email from. Registering null, nothing invented.

images_curation_notes: Downloaded and visually inspected every logo/cover/bizPhoto/inspiration image (17) plus the top 8 review photos (10 available) from the Booksy payload before choosing. Excluded from the site: images with the 'Cuban Clips' gold watermark/logo overlay burned into the photo (insp-4, insp-5 duplicate covered by watermark, insp-7, insp-8, biz-6), an odd top-down/upside-down face angle with closed eyes (insp-5, insp-6), and a run of near-duplicate bathroom-mirror selfies with visible clutter (cosmetics shelves, toilet, phone in frame) from one reviewer (rev-3 through rev-8). Kept 11 real, well-lit, finished-result photos plus the logo. All images resized to max 1000px width (JPEG quality ~82) before use; the two PNG source photos were converted to JPEG.
language_note: Business bio on Booksy is written in English. All 10 most recent reviews are in English. Service names are in English. English selected as the primary/default site language; Spanish translations added for the bilingual toggle per DESIGN.md.
brand_vibe: Barbershop logo is a polished gold monogram (interlocking C's around a barber pole with a crescent moon) on black leather-textured background: masculine, premium, dark. Real haircut photos show sharp, high-contrast fades, lineups and freehand nape/side designs. Palette derived from the real logo: warm near-black background (#100d0b) with a gold/bronze accent family (#d8b46a deep, #b8935a mid, #a89478 soft), distinct hex values from other Siteforge builds while keeping the same dark-luxury structure as the ejemplar templates.
